description: Get daily weather for a location — works for BOTH historical weather (past dates) and forecast (future or no dates). Use this for HISTORICAL weather and "weather on a past date" questions, e.g. "what was the weather in Paris on 2023-07-04" (location: "Paris", start_date: "2023-07-04"). Pass start_date alone for a single day, or start_date + end_date for a range (weather timeline). Returns per-day temp/min/max, humidity, precipitation, wind, and conditions. Example: weather_timeline({ location: "London", start_date: "2024-01-01", end_date: "2024-01-07" }).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Visual Crossing API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

end_date.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Only used when start_date is also given; produces a date-range timeline.

start_date.description: Optional start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Past dates return HISTORICAL weather; future dates return forecast. Omit for the default 15-day forecast.

units.description: Unit group: "metric" (°C, km/h — default), "us" (°F, mph), or "uk".

name: weather_timeline
title: Weather Timeline
